Coverage test against the anchors: Marcus (no mass seizure of allegedly obscene materials without focused procedures/adversary determination) and Roaden (no warrantless seizure of a film incident to arrest; 'scrupulous exactitude' context) are both prohibitions. Of the four candidates, only Heller carries a distinct load-bearing affirmative rule an officer must execute correctly (evidentiary single-copy seizure + prompt hearing + copying proviso) — elevate it. Lee Art (affidavit adequacy), P.J. Video (ordinary PC standard), and Fort Wayne (no bulk pretrial seizure) each reduce to one-line rules fully expressible as Lower-court-developments-style bullets/mentions under the anchors and Stanford; none is named in corpus prose today, so the D1 flip does not force pages and the D5-style floor counsels bullets.
